title: Extension Maximum Level for Calloway Homeowners — Homesite Reservation
content:
The extension maximum level of a Homesite Reservation hold extension depends on the buyer's Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, read from its owner type and status.

**Clause.** The extension maximum level is the class's maximum total hold days plus **6** days for a buyer whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage shows owner type original buyer and status active, the class's maximum total hold days plus **3** days for a buyer whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage shows owner type subsequent owner and status active, and the class's maximum total hold days for every other buyer.

## Combinations

| Owner type | Status | Extension maximum level |
|---|---|---|
| original buyer | active | maximum total hold days plus 6 |
| subsequent owner | active | maximum total hold days plus 3 |
| original buyer or subsequent owner | transferred | maximum total hold days |
| original buyer or subsequent owner | expired | maximum total hold days |
| no Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage | | maximum total hold days |

## Illustration (hypothetical class maximum total hold days of 17)

An active original buyer: 23 days. An active subsequent owner: 20 days. A buyer whose coverage shows status expired: 17 days.
